_comment: Model providers for --model <provider>:<model> (chd_client.models.registry). A name without ':' is an Anthropic model. kind is the adapter: anthropic | openrouter | openai_compatible. Keys are environment variable NAMES, never values (a key that goes in a header: headers_env). config/providers.local.json (gitignored) replaces entries of the same name and adds new ones. cost: 'reported' (the reply carries usage.cost: kind openrouter and x_gateway entries only) or 'estimated' (prices per model, USD per million tokens); a model without a price is refused before the run (the runner stops on any unknown cost, whatever --cost-cap).

routing._comment: OpenRouter's request `provider` object per model (chd_client.models.registry.routing_for): the model's own key, else the longest vendor prefix ("google/"), else "default"; the rule that matches is sent whole. Privacy: data_collection deny = no provider that stores or trains on prompts; zdr true = zero-data-retention endpoints only. Google's endpoints keep prompts their safety filter flags (up to 90 days, no training: OpenRouter 'Safety Retention'), so the other models ignore google-vertex; Google's own models have only such endpoints, so they keep Google. Claude's order (amazon-bedrock, google-vertex: both ZDR) is in the code, these fields go on top. Check a slug at https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/endpoints/zdr (safety_retention).

openai/gpt-6.1-sol._comment: This model on OpenAI only. Azure (its only zero-retention endpoint) takes at most 50 images per request and Amazon Bedrock at most 100, fewer than a long episode sends. OpenAI keeps prompts for abuse checks (no training: data_collection deny). Requests that OpenRouter's moderation flags can run on openrouter_bedrock (below).

openrouter_bedrock._comment: A fallback route for requests that OpenRouter's moderation flags on OpenAI (CT renders as 'violence/graphic'): Amazon Bedrock, which takes at most 100 images per request, so run it with --max-images 96. Otherwise as the openrouter entry.

local._comment: The local model gateway (chd-gateway). It replies in one piece (it refuses stream: true) and reports usage.cost 0.0.

openai._comment: effort null: --effort is not sent (gpt-4o and gpt-4.1 refuse reasoning_effort). For a reasoning model, set "effort": "reasoning_effort" in your copy of this entry in config/providers.local.json. max_output_tokens: gpt-4o 16384, from https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-4o ("16,384 max output tokens"). Keep it in your copy.

cost._comment: OpenAI does not report a cost. Copy this entry to config/providers.local.json (an entry there replaces this one) and add each model you run with the prices from OpenAI's price page, USD per million tokens: "<model>": {"input_per_mtok": x, "output_per_mtok": y, "cached_input_per_mtok": z}. A model without a price is refused (never an invented cost).
